name: goods-receipt-confirmation-artifact-guard-rollback-failure
identitySource: Existing administrator profile selected inside SQL; authenticated role/JWT claims simulated for database guard testing; no email or user ID stored

attempt.product: synthetic draft with combo_items=[] and testArtifact metadata
attempt.receipt: one synthetic test item, quantity 1, unit cost 2.50
attempt.operation: invoke the authenticated checked confirmation RPC in one explicit PostgreSQL transaction

failure.source: confirm_goods_receipt_transaction writes inventory_moves.order_id=receipt_id with related_entity_type=goods_receipt; guard_test_artifact_record treats every order_id as an orders link and rejects the receipt UUID

transactionEffectsBeforeFailure: synthetic product and its default variation were inserted inside the transaction
the receipt header and receipt item were inserted inside the transaction
inventory move insertion was rejected before stock-delta application

followUp.proof: A later checked-RPC confirmation with one synthetic item created an effective receipt movement and stock delta inside an explicit transaction, then rolled back to zero rows with the receipt sequence unchanged.

riskBoundary: At the time of this probe, the guard's order-link interpretation blocked a normal receipt movement; the transaction rolled back fully. The guard and search_path corrections were applied later and are documented in followUp.
